## Research Papers & Publications

- [SLTE Generative AI & Synthetic Data Research Paper](https://theniyazkhan.bond/#efast-2026-synthetic-data): **"Can Synthetic Data Replace Real Data? Evaluating the Efficacy, Limits, and Label Trustworthiness of Generative Data in Supervised Learning"** (Accepted at EFAST 2026). Authors: Niyaz Ahmad Khan, Yousuf Bin Nazib, Golam M Naeem, Eshrath Jahan Esha, Islam Uddin, Abu Ubayda. Evaluates CTGAN-generated tabular synthetic data using a medical dataset of 110,527 records with a 4:1 class imbalance. Defines synthetic label corruption and introduces the **Synthetic Label Trustworthiness Estimation (SLTE)** framework, incorporating KNN label correction and confidence routing to narrow performance gaps in tabular machine learning models.
- [Social Media Behavioral Economics Research Paper](https://theniyazkhan.bond/#nicsdg-2026-social-media): **"The Impact of Social Media Use on Student Productivity: A Behavioral Economics Perspective"** (Abstract Accepted at NICSDG-2026). Authors: Niyaz Ahmad Khan, Yousuf Bin Nazib, Shahriar Najim. Applies behavioral economics constructs (nudge theory, present bias) to evaluate screen time and notification frequency across 6,000 student profiles. Identifies notification-driven attention disruption and self-control failure as major determinants of academic productivity loss.
- [Student Performance Prediction Thesis Paper](https://theniyazkhan.bond/#thesis-student-performance): **"Student Performance Prediction Using Machine Learning"** (Metropolitan University AI Course Thesis, 2025). Authors: Niyaz Ahmad Khan, Eshrath Jahan Esha. Evaluates supervised machine learning algorithms to predict student final exam outcomes based on demographic and academic engagement variables across 708 students.

## Software Engineering Projects

- [Sylheti Programming Language & Web Compiler](https://theniyazkhan.bond/Sylheti-Compiler): An educational domain-specific programming language and interactive web compiler created for the Sylheti dialect. Features a client-side lexical analyzer, recursive descent AST parser, runtime interpreter, and web sandbox. Live demo at [https://theniyazkhan.bond/Sylheti-Compiler](https://theniyazkhan.bond/Sylheti-Compiler).
- [CampusBite (Canteen Pre-Order & Queue Management Platform)](https://github.com/theniyazkhan): Full-stack web platform designed to eliminate university canteen queue congestion through real-time order scheduling, live kitchen dashboards, and automated stock forecasting. Built with Vue.js, Node.js, Express, MySQL, and UptimeRobot API.
- [HealthBridge (Unified Healthcare & Donor Portal)](https://github.com/theniyazkhan/HealthBridge): Database-centric medical web ecosystem facilitating real-time blood donor geolocation searches, doctor appointment scheduling, and pharmacy stock management with normalized SQL query optimization. Built with HTML, CSS, PHP, and MySQL.
- [Parlor Management System (Desktop Salon Software)](https://github.com/theniyazkhan/parlourmanagementsysyem): Desktop software featuring a custom dark-themed Swing UI, customer treatment suggestions based on historical data, revenue analytics charts, and offline database synchronization. Built with Java, Java Swing, and MySQL.
- [Personal Portfolio Source Code](https://github.com/theniyazkhan): Interactive Vue 3 portfolio featuring scroll-reveal engine, glassmorphism UI, vector kitten companion, and AI assistant query engine. Built with Vue.js 3, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.
